items.title: Vargottama
items.summary: The same sign in both Rasi and Navamsa amplifies and stabilizes a planet's results, for better or worse.
items.effects: When a planet lands in the same sign in both the Rasi (D1, the birth chart itself) and Navamsa (D9, the chart of marriage, dharma, and inner strength) charts, its placement is considered unusually consistent and reinforced across both levels - classically read as a meaningful STRENGTHENING of that planet's results, roughly comparable in significance to being in its own sign. This amplifies whatever the placement already indicates: a well-placed, well-dignified Vargottama planet performs especially reliably, while a poorly-placed or afflicted one has its difficulties reinforced just as consistently - Vargottama intensifies rather than automatically improves.
